teaser.en: One shrub, three Digo names: the twiner, Msuko, and the rib plant used against convulsions.
teaser.sw: Kichaka kimoja, majina matatu ya Kidigo: kinachojisokota, Msuko, na mmea wa mbavu unaotumika dhidi ya degedege.

summary.en: This Msokoto is Grewia holstii, a scrambling shrub of coastal bush. Pakia records it as a remedy, under the name Mbavubavu, for convulsions affecting the rib cage.
summary.sw: Msokoto huu ni Grewia holstii, kichaka kinachotambaa katika vichaka vya pwani. Pakia anaurekodi kama dawa, kwa jina Mbavubavu, ya degedege linaloathiri mbavu.

about.en: Grewia holstii is a scrambling shrub or liana-like bush with long, arching branches. Its leaves are alternate, toothed and three-veined from the base, and its small flowers are yellowish with five narrow petals. The fruits are small, two- to four-lobed and orange-brown when ripe.
about.sw: Grewia holstii ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kichaka kinachofanana na mtambaa, chenye matawi marefu yaliyopinda kama tao. Majani yake yanapishana, yana meno na mishipa mitatu kutoka kwenye kitako, na maua yake madogo ni ya manjano hafifu yenye petali tano nyembamba. Matunda ni madogo, yenye pindo mbili hadi nne, na ya rangi ya chungwa-kahawia yakiiva.

where.en: It grows in dry coastal bushland and thicket, often climbing through other shrubs.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu na vichaka-mwitu vizito vya pwani, mara nyingi ukipanda kupitia vichaka vingine.

uses.en: Pakia's naming appendix lists Grewia holstii, with G. forbesii, as Mbavubavu, used to treat nyuni wa mbavuni, convulsions affecting the rib cage. This is reported practice, not advice.
uses.sw: Kiambatisho cha majina cha Pakia kinaorodhesha Grewia holstii, pamoja na G. forbesii, kama Mbavubavu, unaotumika kutibu nyuni wa mbavuni, degedege linaloathiri mbavu. Huu ni utaratibu ulioripotiwa, si ushauri.

culture.en: Pakia uses Mbavubavu to show how one Digo name can cover several scientific species: the Digo treat Grewia holstii and G. ectasicarpa as one kind of plant.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia Mbavubavu kuonyesha jinsi jina moja la Kidigo linavyoweza kujumuisha spishi kadhaa za kisayansi: Wadigo huichukulia Grewia holstii na G. ectasicarpa kuwa aina moja ya mmea.

names.en: Pakia records three Digo names. Msokoto, 'twine', from sokota (to twist), is shared with Swahili. Mbavubavu, 'rib', is shared with Duruma and Giriama. Msuko is also used for Colubrina asiatica, and no meaning is given for it. Msokoto and Mbavubavu are also used for Grewia ectasicarpa.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina matatu ya Kidigo. Msokoto, 'kusokota', kutoka sokota, linatumika pia kwa Kiswahili. Mbavubavu, 'mbavu', linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma na Kigiriama. Msuko hutumika pia kwa Colubrina asiatica, na maana yake haitolewi. Msokoto na Mbavubavu hutumika pia kwa Grewia ectasicarpa.

reason.en: Large Mbavubavu, the other rib remedy
reason.sw: Mbavubavu mkubwa, dawa nyingine ya mbavu
